open_points.text: - create_budget_schema: [CONFIG_REFERENCE] MUST idempotently create only the budget-version table named = config.persistence.budget_version_table_name and the section-plan table named = config.persistence.section_plan_table_name, each name written as a fixed name in the SQL text, with columns corresponding one-to-one to BudgetVersion and SectionPlan fields; version_id and plan_id are primary keys, the combination of version_id and section_id is unique, and nullable model fields remain nullable.
open_points.other_text: Use only the IMPORTS listed above plus required standard library imports.
open_points.question: Must the config references be replaced with the actual fixed table names, or must the required config symbols be added to IMPORTS?
